mixed_paragraph.text: For f in Y_delta,0 the physical complete L2 inverse gives a unique Q-perpendicular psi. It has local elliptic regularity. On the cusp, the zero-angular homogeneous solutions of (1) have exponents -beta_c and 1+beta_c. The growing solution is excluded by the actual vector measure exp(-t)dt. For c=0 only a constant Q term remains, with a decaying particular solution for the given decaying source. For c>0 the source variation-of-constants integral and the admitted decaying homogeneous solution belong to C_delta. The strict choice of delta avoids resonance with every such homogeneous exponent.
